title: Summer 2027 Internship - Sage Sales - Cary, IL
description:
Job Description

This fast-paced, multifaceted position will work directly with Sales while collaborating cross departmentally to directly sell (virtually) to targeted accounts and clinicians for maximum impact and sales growth. This position will be trained in account management, product and clinical competencies and spend coordinated time with Sales Training, Customer1, National Accounts, and Marketing to develop an actionable selling strategy. This role will promote the Stryker “culture” and help maintain strong communication throughout the organization.

$20 min hourly wage – $35 max hourly wage, sign-on bonus, 11 paid holidays annually, and either paid corporate housing or a living stipend, dependent upon hiring location

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.
